models.title: DTH-SC overlay 0.1.0-draft.1
models.description: The dth-sc overlay on the smart-ra (DPI-H RA) ArchiMate model 0.3.0-draft.1: the five architecture variants of the supply chain DTH (Figs 15-19). Elements tagged overlay:base copy a smart-ra element and name it by IRI; elements tagged overlay:owner=dth-sc are this DTH's own (dth-sc#2 SC3).
